required_anchor_points: Separate runtime checkpoint state from durable knowledge.
Recognize that node-level checkpointing does not preserve a completed worker result inside an unfinished node.
SQLite is acceptable for the current single-host low-concurrency baseline.
Provide a migration path toward PostgreSQL when concurrent writers or multiple runtime processes become material.
Do not treat the superseded Redis proposal as current architecture authority.
Identify worker-level result persistence as a remaining reliability gap.
